utility.notes: King City is a well-documented Monterey County city within PG&E's core Northern California service territory.

value.name: Central Coast Community Energy (3CE)
value.notes: 3CE's own official site confirms it serves Monterey County, which includes King City. PG&E continues to deliver the power and provide billing/customer service. King City was not individually named in 3CE's member-community list surfaced this session, but is confirmed part of Monterey County, which 3CE serves; confidence set slightly below the batch baseline to reflect the county-level (not city-named) confirmation.

permit_url.notes: The department's page links to SolarApp+ (solarapp.nrel.gov) but did not itself itemize solar-specific submittal requirements, fees, or timelines.

interconnection_url.notes: PG&E's own utility-wide Net Energy Metering (NEM) program page.

value.name: SGIP - Residential Solar and Storage Equity
value.administrator: Pacific Gas and Electric Company (PG&E), under the CPUC's Self-Generation Incentive Program
value.description: Storage incentive of $1,100/kWh paired with a solar incentive of $3,100/kW, funded via a $280 million CPUC-authorized statewide budget that opened for reservations June 2, 2025 and remains an active program per SGIP's own statewide announcements (most recently dated 2026-07-23). Administered across PG&E's entire distribution territory, which includes King City/Monterey County.
value.eligibility: PG&E, SCE, or SDG&E residential customers (general market tier)

battery_programs.notes: Reused as a utility-level fact already established for other IOU-territory records this session: the CPUC-administered SGIP program applies uniformly across the named utility's entire distribution territory, directly verified via SGIP's own site (selfgenca.com) / the CPUC's own SGIP program page, including a program-status announcement as recent as 2026-07-23 confirming the program remains active.
